target_customer: Data, growth and ops teams and AI companies that need structured web data (customers named include Snapchat and OpenAI per YC page; Zeffy and others in testimonials)
problem: Teams spend hours copying data from the web or months building scrapers. Riveter runs AI search agents that find, read and structure web data at scale through one API.
business_model: usage-based API and app subscription for web data extraction
product_category: AI web search and data extraction agents

founders.name: Abby Grills
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable browsing agents, scrapers and structured outputs at low cost per cell require engineering on top of LLMs; many pieces were available in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Clay, Firecrawl, Exa and others offer overlapping data extraction and enrichment; the underlying models are shared.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors added agentic parallel enrichment features by 2026 per vendor changelogs found; no acquisition of Riveter found.

market_need_then: Companies were paying contractors or building scrapers to gather product, pricing and KYB data, and LLM browsing made automation viable. Claygent had been introduced in 2023 by Clay per Clay's own guide.

branding.domain_note: Uses riveterhq.com, a suffix variant; other companies (The Riveter, R. Riveter) share the name.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and enterprise-focused; tagline Accurate web search at scale

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself; the name is shared with other better-known Riveter companies, which hurts search.

outcome_analysis: Riveter is a two-person Fall 2024 company founded by ex-Gusto, Middesk and Retool staff that sells AI web data agents and says OpenAI and Snapchat are customers. No priced round is verifiable and competition from Clay, Firecrawl and Exa is strong, so the outcome is undetermined.
notes: Aggregators list about 500K pre-seed; unverified, not recorded as a round. One profile names Erica Clark as a third founder; not on the YC page, so omitted. The competitor search returned only 2026 vendor pages, none dated near the batch, so the list is empty. The brand search returned an unrelated company (R. Riveter) and was discarded. Customer claims are from the YC page.
